title: Impact report assembly
responsibility: Turns kernel reachability into affected units, tests and scenarios, widening selection when changes cannot be safely bounded.

inputs.name: impactReport.input
inputs.description: An assembly of base and head impact sides, classified change seeds, and the kernel's affected and uncovered output. The head side supplies the available tests and scenarios; seed expansions and uncovered changed source files determine whether selection widens to all current tests and scenarios.

inputs.name: graphTests.graph
inputs.description: A source graph whose nodes are scanned for tests. A node is returned only when its kind is `test` and its ID matches the .test or .spec JavaScript/TypeScript filename pattern; the returned path has the leading `file:` removed.

outputs.name: graphTests
outputs.description: Repository paths derived from matching test-node IDs after removing the `file:` prefix. Only test nodes with .test or .spec JavaScript/TypeScript extensions are returned.

outputs.name: impactReport
outputs.description: A report assembled from changed seeds, affected nodes, and the head graph and scenarios. Seed expansions or uncovered changed source files set expanded and select every current head test and scenario; otherwise selection follows reachable affected files and scenarios, with sorted unit, test, and scenario lists and deduplicated uncertainty.
